moments.text: Phone video of a light infrared screen: tick-marked crosshair, two small rings and a triangle just below-right of centre. A tiny dark dot moves around beside them.
The phone shifts, showing the screen's dark left edge; the two rings and triangle hold their place below-right of the crosshair.
The rings-and-triangle group vanishes, leaving one ring, and the picture flickers bright and dark as the sensor switches mode.
New mode: a mottled, wave-textured grey background. One ring sits right of centre and another near the lower-right edge.
The display flashes white, then shows a black view with a white crosshair for 3 frames (~0.1 s), then white again.
Back on the light picture, the two rings and triangle return below-right of the crosshair and stay to the end.
